A session whose terminal-host agent has exited can therefore retain live old tabs. core.rs:13307-13376 checks current/recorded terminal hosts and hosts.live_tabs only, permitting NothingAlive when they are ended/empty; old tmux tabs are never consulted. teardown.rs:402-418 requires the full sweep for later-generation host rows; its WholeSession target can find the old tab through the session marker or its enumerated tab scope and stop it. Successful cleanup is not confirmation authority. SPEC.md:2048-2056 says 'a destructive confirmation authorizes only what the prompt the user answered said would happen' and a Delete showing nothing alive 'is refused if the agent or any terminal tab is running'. Suggested bucket: highest, conditional on the source-established old-server connection failure and surviving live tab, because a live editor or other process in the undisclosed tab can lose user work when stopped.
